text: The Paramecium 'avoiding reaction' (backward swimming, turning, then forward swimming in a new direction) is triggered when depolarization opens voltage-gated channels that admit an influx of ___ ions, reversing the ciliary beat (Eckert, 1972).
explanation: The answer is calcium. Roger Eckert established that calcium influx through voltage-gated channels in the anterior membrane drives ciliary reversal and therefore the avoiding reaction, a biophysical mechanism (electrical signaling plus calcium as a second messenger) structurally homologous to neural signaling.
